summary: Iteration 63 — Frontend-only verification of admin /admin/leads (Data) page filter rework. All 10 required data-testids present. 'Assigned To' multi-select: trigger opens menu (data-testid filter-assigned-menu), contains 'Unassigned' + 19 GP options; selecting 2 GPs → label 'Assigned To (2)', total count 519→15 (OR filter working); adding Unassigned → label 'Assigned To (3)', count 17 (unassigned OR-expansion works). Clearing via X returns to 519. 'Previously Assigned To' multi-select: opens with 116 options including 'Inactive' tagged GPs (e.g. 'KAVALI VARUN KUMAR Inactive'), select-2 shows label 'Previously Assigned To (2)' and filters cleanly (0 results, no error). Status chips regression OK (All Status 519, New 3). Combined filters (2 GPs + Company='TestCompanyXYZ') returned 0 without runtime error and page stayed mounted. Uploaded date range (2026-01-01 → 2026-12-31) triggered list refresh (518). No page crashes, no runtime errors from Leads page in the console (only pre-existing benign hydration warnings from ve-dynamic instrumentation on Dashboard/LeadCard — unrelated to this change).
critical_code_review_comments: MultiSelectDropdown.js: outside-click uses mousedown on document to close, which is fine. Note the small X 'clear' icon inside the trigger button is a nested clickable inside a <button>. It stops propagation with e.stopPropagation() so it won't toggle open — works, but nesting an interactive icon inside a <button> is invalid HTML; consider changing the outer to a <div role='button'> or use a sibling absolute-positioned clear button.
The clear-X on the trigger is only visible when count>0; works as expected. There is no 'X' when nothing selected — good.

Pre-existing (not from this change): Dashboard/LeadCard hydration warnings from ve-dynamic instrumentation (<span> wrapping <select>/<option>/<tr>/<tbody>/<table>/<tfoot>). Noisy but non-blocking; already flagged in prior iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Data page filter rework verified. Assigned To multi (with Unassigned OR-expansion), Previously Assigned To multi (including Inactive tagged GPs), text filters (company/source), and date ranges all wired to backend and update counts without runtime errors. Trigger label format '<placeholder> (<n>)' confirmed. Clear-X on trigger fully resets. No further action needed.
